2. The opposite party Nos. 1 to 5 Rabindra Chandra Saha and others as plaintiffs filed Other Class Suit No. 212 of 1993 in the Court of Subordinate Judge for declaration of Title in respect of "Ka" scheduled land, for the recovery of "khas" possession after evicting the defendant No. 1 Ayesha Khatun, demolishing and removing the dwelling house of the defendant No. 1 thereon and for the declaration of the kabala deed No. 2373 dated 5-5-1969 executed by the defendant No.2 in favour of defendant No. 1 as illegal, collusive, ineffective, created by false personification and not binding upon the plaintiffs and for further declaration that no part and parcel of the suit property was declared as vested property. 

 3. The case of the plaintiffs, inter alia, is that including other land, the alleged 0.21 acre of land belonged to Nabin Chandra Saha in khas and the rest of the land belonged to Gobinda Chandra Saha and Guruchandra Saha and in settlement survey Maliki Khatian No. 86 was published in the name of  Nabinchandra and Khatian No. 88 in the name of Gobinda Chandra and others; that in the said Khatian, one Ragunath Chandra was shown as permissive possessor in the remark column and after the survey the said Ragunath Chandra left for elsewhere, delivering the possession of the suit land in favour of Nab in Chandra Saha and others and by  an amicable settlement Nabin Chandra Saha got the entire land of suit plot with other land in his saham and other co-sharers got other land, that while possessing in such way Nabin Chandra died, leaving his only son, Jagabandhu  Saha, who inherited the same and as per provisions of State Acquisition and Tenancy Act, the khas Khamar title was converted into Raiyati jote title under the Government; that Jagabandu used to possess the suit land by erecting dwelling house which was a simple thatched hut but the remaining portion of land was an unused plot of land, 

 19. It is admitted that the suit land measuring 32 decimals appertaining to RoR plot No. 928 of RoR khatian No.416 corresponding to settlement plot No. 995 of settlement khatian No. 86 and 88 of Mouza Bajitpur under Kishoreganj District originally belonged to Nabin Chandra Saha in khas and the rest of the land belonged to Gobinda Chandra Saha and Guru Chandra Saha and in settlement survey Maliki khatian No. 86 Exhibit-1 was published in the name of Nobin Chandra and Khatian No.88 Exhibit 1(ka) in the name of Gobindra Chandra Saha and others.
